newsitem.title: USA: US cash grades wind down Apr business, roll jumpy.
newsitem.headline: US cash grades wind down Apr business, roll jumpy.

text.p: U.S. cash crude grades were erratic on Friday, with refiners winding down their April pipeline business at fluctuating prices.
Traders said the April/May West Texas Intermediate/Cushing "roll" moved all the way from minus 15 cents to positive 12 cts in the course of trading.
Other grade prices saw sweet crude barrels in both Louisiana and Texas firm slightly, while sour differentials hung at even prices.
Outright April WTI/Cushing was around $21.70-80 a barrel heading into late afternoon activity.
April grade business must be completed by Tuesday, the deadline for pipeline scheduling, leaving today for last minute number crunching by the majors, traders said.
Midland/WTI moved down to a 20 cts discount to the WTI/Cushing, after trading Thursday at minus 27-28 cts.
Heavy Louisiana Sweet/Empire moved at WTI/Cushing minus 60 and 55 cts, steady from late talk Thursday.
West Texas Sour/Midland sold at WTI/Cushing -$2.55, and Eugene Island at a $2.40 discount to the same marker.
Apr Postings Plus was done at $1.80 and $1.85, but has moved widely in conjuntion with the Apr/May roll.
